scope: TETAMU PCB 2026 VC1 dirty-worktree isolation and candidate provenance

classificationDefinitions.VC1_REQUIRED: Direct PCB VC1 implementation, evidence, migration, UI, or regression coverage.
classificationDefinitions.VC1_DEPENDENCY: Existing cross-module dependency proven necessary to compile or preserve relevant Payroll behavior.
classificationDefinitions.UNRELATED: Existing user work outside PCB VC1 and excluded from candidate commits.
classificationDefinitions.MIXED_HUNKS: One path contains both PCB-required and unrelated hunks; only the isolated PCB state is in Commit A.
classificationDefinitions.UNKNOWN: Unrecognized untracked artifact, preserved without interpretation.
